docs.title: Aura Workforce Security Hub
docs.text:
Welcome to the Aura Workforce Security Hub.

This website presents cybersecurity documentation, security findings, risk assessments, policies and security monitoring information.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.text:
• Executive Summary
  • Security Findings
  • Risk Register
  • Security Policies
  • Detection Documentation
  • Hosting Comparison

docs.title: Project Objectives
docs.text:
1. Identify and document security risks.
  2. Improve security awareness.
  3. Establish access control policies.
  4. Document security monitoring practices.
  5. Support incident response preparation.

docs.title: Project Scope
docs.text: This Hub is an educational cybersecurity project. All examples use fictional training data.

docs.title: Important Notice
docs.text:
This documentation is intended for educational and defensive cybersecurity purposes only.

Vulnerable laboratory applications are maintained separately in a private, local environment.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Aura Workforce Security Hub is a cybersecurity documentation project focused on security awareness, risk management and defensive monitoring.

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Improve security visibility.
  • Document security risks.
  • Establish security policies.
  • Support incident response.
  • Maintain security monitoring documentation.

docs.title: Expected Outcomes
docs.text: A structured security documentation platform with clear policies, findings and recommendations.

docs.title: Fictional Training Data Notice
docs.text:
This Security Hub is an educational cybersecurity project.

All names, findings, risks, events and examples presented in this public documentation are fictional.

No real customer information, employee information, passwords, authentication tokens or confidential business information are included.

Vulnerable applications used for practical learning are maintained separately in a private local lab.

This website must not be used as a guide to attack real systems.

docs.title: Sensitive Content Review Checklist
docs.text:
Item Status Real employee names removed PASS Real customer information removed PASS Passwords and API keys removed PASS Tokens and cookies removed PASS Private IP and infrastructure details reviewed PASS Exploit instructions removed PASS Real security incident details removed PASS Vulnerable lab files excluded PASS Fictional training disclaimer included PASS

Review status: Example checklist only. Final PASS status must be confirmed through an actual manual review before publication.

docs.title: Detection 1: Repeated Failed Logins
docs.text:
Objective: Identify unusual authentication failures.

Severity: Medium

Recommended action: Review authentication events and investigate suspicious patterns.

docs.title: Detection 2: Privileged Access Changes
docs.text:
Objective: Monitor unexpected permission changes.

Severity: High

Recommended action: Review authorization records and validate approved administrative activity.

docs.title: Detection 3: Unusual Account Activity
docs.text:
Objective: Identify unexpected account behaviour.

Severity: Medium

Recommended action: Review relevant security logs.

docs.title: Security Findings
docs.text:
ID Finding Severity Recommendation F-01 Weak password policy Medium Improve password controls F-02 Excessive user permissions High Apply least privilege F-03 Insufficient monitoring Medium Improve log monitoring F-04 Missing security awareness Low Conduct awareness training F-05 Incomplete incident documentation Medium Maintain response procedures

All findings are fictional training examples.

docs.text: Feature GitHub Pages Netlify Vercel Starting price Free tier Free tier Free tier Git integration Yes Yes Yes Private repository support Plan-dependent Yes Yes Custom domain Yes Yes Yes Deployment GitHub Actions Automatic Automatic Ease of use Easy Very easy Easy Static documentation Suitable Suitable Suitable

docs.title: Final Decision
docs.text:
Netlify is selected for publishing the Aura Workforce Security Hub.

The GitHub repository will remain private, while only sanitized static documentation will be published.

Pricing, usage limits and commercial-use conditions must be checked against the current provider plans.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Ensure that users receive only the access required for their responsibilities.

docs.title: Policy Requirements
docs.text:
• Apply least-privilege access.
  • Review permissions periodically.
  • Remove access when no longer required.
  • Use approved authentication methods.
  • Maintain access review records.

docs.title: Responsibility
docs.text: Administrators are responsible for access management and periodic reviews.

docs.title: Response Stages
docs.text:
1. Preparation
  2. Identification
  3. Containment
  4. Eradication
  5. Recovery
  6. Lessons Learned

docs.title: Documentation
docs.text: Record incident dates, impact, response decisions and lessons learned using fictional training examples for this public documentation.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• Use unique passwords.
  • Never share passwords.
  • Use approved password managers.
  • Enable multi-factor authentication.
  • Change compromised credentials promptly.

docs.title: Monitoring
docs.text: Review authentication events and investigate suspicious activity.
